surface_mechanism_description: The formation of tetragonal HfO2 on the rutile structured TiO2 resulted from the structural compatibility of the specific planes of the tetragonal HfO2 and rutile structured TiO2.
evidence: The formation of tetragonal HfO2 on the rutile structured TiO2 resulted from the structural compatibility of the specific planes of the tetragonal HfO2 and rutile structured TiO2.
